subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a default-disabled agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs config key plus shared command-queue onTaskTimeout hook as the supported fix for deferred turn-maintenance stalls?
rationale: The code path is a plausible owner-boundary fix, but the new config/default surface and shared queue callback become supported compatibility contracts once merged.

options.title: Accept the opt-in timeout contract
options.body: Merge after maintainers confirm that default-disabled configuration and a shared queue timeout hook are the desired compatibility boundary.

options.title: Narrow the queue API first
options.body: Replace the shared onTaskTimeout option with a maintenance-local mechanism if maintainers do not want this queue contract.

options.title: Split policy follow-ups
options.body: Let this PR address the timeout/fence gap and leave burst coalescing or shorter recovery thresholds for separate review.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in timeout contract
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainers confirm that default-disabled configuration and a shared queue timeout hook are the desired compatibility boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman authored or merged the core context-engine maintenance and background turn-maintenance features affected by this contract choice.
